email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm writing to apply for the Digital Marketing Specialist role at Method Media Intelligence. Your focus on multi-channel campaigns and measurable results matches how I work: I plan, execute and optimize campaigns across SEO, content, paid search and social, and I track everything in Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs.

In my current roles, I handle on-page SEO, keyword research and SEO content for client websites, manage WordPress and Shopify stores, and run Google Ads campaigns. I also build landing pages and use AI tools and Python to automate reporting and audits, which keeps campaigns efficient and data-driven.

I'd welcome the chance to bring this mix of creative content and technical analysis to your team and to help grow your clients' brands.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm applying for the Digital Marketing Specialist position at Method Media Intelligence. Your emphasis on planning, executing and optimizing multi-channel campaigns to drive measurable results is exactly the kind of work I do and enjoy.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketing roles, I manage SEO and content for client websites, run keyword research, and track performance with Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs. I've built and optimized WordPress and Shopify sites, including landing pages and product catalogues, and I've run Google Ads campaigns. I also use AI tools and Python to automate repetitive tasks like audits and reporting, which helps me focus on strategy and creative work.

What draws me to this role is the combination of creative campaign work and analytical rigor. I like digging into data to see what's working, then adjusting ad copy, landing pages or targeting to improve conversions. I've done this for clients in consultancy and e-commerce, and I've seen how small technical and content changes can lift organic traffic and search visibility.

I work independently but also collaborate closely with designers, developers and content teams. I'm comfortable communicating with clients and explaining performance in clear terms. I'm eager to bring my mix of SEO, content, paid search and automation skills to your team and to help grow your clients' brands.

Thank you for considering my application. I'd be glad to discuss how I can contribute.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
